title.zh: 虚拟内存是怎么工作的

desc.zh: 每个程序都以为自己独占一整块从 0 开始的内存，几十个程序却挤在同一条内存里。CPU 每读一个字节都要先翻译地址，为什么还不慢？十一个可以动手的模型：连续分配与外部碎片、页表的大小、x86-64 四级页表逐位走一遍、TLB 与它的覆盖范围、页表遍历缓存、大页、缺页的代价、FIFO 与 LRU 与时钟算法、写时复制、PCID 与 KPTI、虚拟机的二维页表。
desc.en: Every program believes it has a whole memory to itself, starting at address 0, while dozens of programs share the same physical memory. The CPU translates an address before every byte it reads; why is that not slow? Eleven hands-on models: contiguous allocation and external fragmentation, the size of a page table, an x86-64 four-level walk bit by bit, the TLB and its reach, the page-walk cache, huge pages, the cost of a page fault, FIFO, LRU and the clock algorithm, copy-on-write, PCID and KPTI, and the two-dimensional walk inside a virtual machine.

desc.zh: 每个进程看到自己从 0 开始的地址空间；连续分配会留下外部碎片，按页分配不需要连续。在一个首次适配分配器上比较两者拒绝了多少进程。
desc.en: Each process sees its own address space starting at 0; contiguous allocation leaves external fragmentation, paging needs no contiguity. A first-fit allocator and a paged one compared on the same arrivals.

title.en: Pages, offsets and multi-level page tables

desc.zh: 地址切成页号和页内偏移；平铺的页表在 48 位地址下要 512 GiB，所以表本身也分页，做成多级的树。
desc.en: An address splits into a page number and an offset; a flat table for 48-bit addresses would need 512 GiB, so the table is paged too and becomes a multi-level tree.

title.zh: x86-64 四级页表逐位走一遍
title.en: An x86-64 four-level page walk, bit by bit

desc.zh: 按 Intel 手册第 5 章，48 位地址切成四个 9 位下标和 12 位偏移，依次读 PML4、PDPT、PD、PT；页表项每一位的意思，规范地址和五级分页。
desc.en: Following chapter 5 of Intel's manual, a 48-bit address splits into four 9-bit indices and a 12-bit offset read through PML4, PDPT, PD and PT; what each bit of an entry means, canonical addresses and five-level paging.

desc.zh: TLB 记住最近的翻译；它管得住的内存是项数乘页大小。在随机读、顺序扫和沿列走三种访问上看缺失率。
desc.en: The TLB remembers recent translations; the memory it covers is entries times page size. Miss rates for random reads, a sequential sweep and a column walk.

title.zh: 一次 TLB 缺失要付多少

desc.zh: 缺失时硬件遍历器去读页表；页表遍历缓存记住上几级的表项，常常只剩最后一次读。用 Zen 5 的两级 TLB 估算每次访问的周期范围。
desc.en: On a miss a hardware walker reads the page tables; a page-walk cache keeps the upper levels so often only the last read is left. Cycles per access bracketed with Zen 5's two TLB levels.

zh: 页表遍历要读几次内存
en: how many memory reads per page walk

desc.zh: 一项映射 2 MiB 或 1 GiB，TLB 覆盖范围大几百倍、遍历少一两级；代价是稀疏使用时多占内存，且需要连续的物理内存。
desc.en: One entry maps 2 MiB or 1 GiB, multiplying TLB reach by hundreds and shortening the walk; the price is wasted memory when use is sparse and the need for contiguous physical memory.

desc.zh: 表项无效时 CPU 交给操作系统；次要缺页不到一微秒，从固态硬盘读几十微秒，从机械硬盘十几毫秒。有效访问时间公式说明缺页率要多低；工作集放不进内存就会抖动。
desc.en: An invalid entry hands control to the operating system; a minor fault takes under a microsecond, a read from an SSD tens of microseconds, from a hard disk over ten milliseconds. The effective-access-time formula shows how rare faults must be; a working set that does not fit makes the machine thrash.

zh: 次要缺页 主要缺页

desc.zh: FIFO、LRU、时钟算法和 OPT 在同一串引用上比较；FIFO 多给页框反而可能缺页更多（Belady 异常），栈算法不会。
desc.en: FIFO, LRU, the clock algorithm and OPT compared on the same reference string; FIFO can fault more with more frames (Belady's anomaly), stack algorithms cannot.

desc.zh: fork 之后父子进程共用全部页框、都标成只读；第一次写才复制那一页。映射文件也走同一条缺页路径。
desc.en: After fork, parent and child share every frame read-only; a page is copied only on its first write. Memory-mapped files take the same page-fault path.

desc.zh: 换进程要换页表；给 TLB 项打上进程标签（PCID）就不必清空。Meltdown 之后 KPTI 每次进出内核都换一次 CR3，有没有 PCID 差别很大。
desc.en: A context switch changes page tables; tagging TLB entries with a process ID (PCID) avoids flushing. After Meltdown, KPTI switches CR3 on every kernel entry and exit, and PCID makes the difference.

zh: 进程切换 TLB 刷新

title.en: Two-dimensional page walks in virtual machines

desc.zh: 客户机的每个表指针还要经宿主机的页表翻译：四级套四级最多读 24 次。大页和遍历缓存在这里更要紧；IOMMU 给设备的也是一套页表。
desc.en: Every guest table pointer is itself translated through the host's tables: up to 24 reads for four levels on four. Huge pages and walk caches matter even more here; the IOMMU is a page table for devices.

title.zh: 虚拟内存的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 五级分页在 Linux 上无条件编进内核，Arm 与苹果的 16 KiB 页，安卓要求应用支持 16 KB 页，CXL 内存成为换页前的新一层。
desc.en: Five-level paging built unconditionally into Linux, 16 KiB pages on Arm and Apple, Android requiring apps to support 16 KB pages, and CXL memory as a new tier before swap.

title.zh: 程序慢的时候问三件事
title.en: Three questions when a program is slow

desc.zh: 工作集有多少页、缺页是哪一种、翻译要套几层。
desc.en: How many pages the working set spans, which kind of page fault it takes, and how many layers of translation it goes through.
